summary.name: MemFree
summary.one_liner: MemFree is a hybrid AI search engine that answers questions using both your own knowledge base (notes, bookmarks, documents) and the open web.
use_cases: search your notes, bookmarks and documents with AI
ask questions about files or images
replace multiple paid AI chatbot subscriptions
get quick sourced answers from the web
summary.what_it_does: MemFree combines a personal knowledge base with live internet search to answer questions. Its workflow decides whether a web search is needed, gathers results from both the web and the user's knowledge base, reranks them by relevance, and uses AI to summarize an answer. It supports asking about text, images, files, and web pages, and can summarize PDFs and web pages. The feature list names several AI models (GPT4o, O1, Claude 3.5, Gemini Pro) and search backends (Google, Exa AI, Vector). It also offers Chrome bookmark sync and indexing, search history sync across devices, and multi-language support.
notable: Hybrid search combining personal knowledge base with live web results
Multi-model access (GPT4o, O1, Claude 3.5, Gemini Pro) in one interface
One-click Chrome bookmarks sync and indexing
Supports local file formats including Txt, PDF, Docx, PPTX, Markdown
caveats: Pricing is not stated on this page
Documentation page only; no details on plan limits or availability
